lines: We defeated the Succubi and proceeded further into the mysterious castle.
Hey, it seems like the inner citadel is never getting any closer.
Uh-hmm, even though it looks like it's right over there...
If only Shikanosuke-chan were here... He has a good sense of direction and could also use his electric waves.
I wondered if Shikanosuke had also been able to reach the castle.
Or maybe it was us who were lost? Maybe we should have searched for Shikanosuke and then gone together after all?
The misty rain that was still falling kept soaking my face.
But I don't think this is simply a case of us getting lost because the way inside the castle is complicated.
Remember what the Succubi we just defeated said: "Stubborn humans who aren't fooled by the illusion."
And there's this rain that both you and Hebiko had a strange feeling about. And the missing Shikanosuke. What if these are all connected...?
Oh? Looks like Fuma-chan had a eureka moment.
...That's it! Hebiko, give me the radio!
The radio? What are you going to do with something like that...
Hebiko rummaged through her bag and found the radio, and I grabbed it from her and turned it on.
Then I moved the outstretched antenna in all directions.
If you don't adjust the frequency you won't hear anything, you know?
As I frantically moved the antenna around, I was able to pick up loud interference from one direction.
If Shikanosuke were lost or trapped, there's no way that scaredy-cat would just sit around and do nothing.
And he knows that Hebiko brought a radio with her. I wouldn't be surprised if he's crying somewhere while sending out electric waves.
I see! That means the interference is caused by Shikanosuke, isn't it?
But even if you know the direction, a maze like this is...
I told you there's a connection between this rain, the maze-like castle, and the disappearance of Shikanosuke, right?
Hmm, would you just spell it out already.
So here's the thing. There's some kind of trick to this rain. It's probably what's producing the effect of the illusion.
We've been lured into an illusory castle and we're being forced to go around in circles.
If it's an illusion, it's understandable that the rumors are different, such as a castle or an old manor appearing on a rainy night.
Sakura-sensei, surely you remember how nothing happened when we came during the day.
Also, the Succubus said something about 'not being fooled by the illusion "right away."'
Shikanosuke was the most frightened among us and was in the worst mental state.
So you mean this rain is affecting our minds and we're being shown illusions!?
But how do you get out if you're already trapped in the illusion??
I pointed to the radio in response to Hebiko's question.
...Looks like the only option for now!
We started walking in the direction the antenna was pointing.
